title: Mastermind
desc: Break a hidden 4-color code in 8 guesses, reading gold and white feedback pegs after every row.

title: Nim
desc: Take 1 to 3 stones from a shared pile against a perfect opponent, in normal or misere rules.

title: Dots and Boxes
desc: Claim the lines between dots to close boxes and outscore the computer or a second player.

title: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
desc: Nine boards inside one master board with the forced-cell send rule, versus a depth-5 AI or a second player.

title: Klondike Solitaire
desc: Classic draw-one Klondike with seven tableau piles, stock and waste, four foundations, undo and full keyboard play.
